scope: Beta release of document adapters/connectors plus supervised local operations, evidence review, paired candidate gates, cache, reviewed case retrieval and integrity tools; existing exact monetary verification remains authoritative. Exact tag/source commit and successful CI are checked separately.
known_limitations: Actual fresh Google Colab acceptance remains not_run; offline notebook checks are separate.
Live cloud-account OAuth/S3 authorization is not established by synthetic connector tests.
The HTTP adapter is a trusted single-machine loopback service, without a production SLA or multi-user identity system.
Full recovery/fault-injection and process-group cancellation validation are scoped to Linux; Windows/macOS have their documented smoke subset.
Case retrieval is advisory and cannot certify a new document; labels bind reviewed CSV but do not authenticate reviewers.
Synthetic workload measurements do not establish production capacity or an automatic learning improvement.
No FX conversion, arbitrary receipt-layout understanding or automatic connector publication.
